bibl.title: The port of Aynuna in pre-Islamic period: nautical and topographical considerations on the location of Leuke Kome.
bibl.seg: Karol Juchniewicz, The port of Aynuna in pre-Islamic period: nautical and topographical considerations on the location of Leuke Kome.
Iwona Zych (ed.), Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/2. Research on the Red Sea (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 31-42, figg.
bibl.note: Tentatively locates ancient Leuke Kome, a Nabatean port which connected Petra with the Red Sea trade network, in Aynuna, east of the entry to the Gulf of Aqaba.
